title: MemoryImportsDiscardRequest
description: Explicit pre-activation rollback: removes all staged data. Valid only before activation; after activation it fails IMPORT_CONFLICT because post-activation rollback is §12.4. Grant: transfer plus admin. Mutating op: requires idempotency_key (§7.0.5) and returns a MemoryReceipt whose result is a content-free summary (§7.0.2).

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen, 1–128 characters (§6.1); unique within the dedup namespace (space_id, requester_principal_id, op, idempotency_key) (§7.0.5).
idempotency_key.title: IdempotencyKey
